question: What primary mineral found in fruits helps regulate blood pressure?
explanation: Potassium assists in maintaining normal blood pressure by reducing the effects of sodium in the vascular system. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h1)

question: Why is dietary fibre from fruits important for the gastrointestinal tract?

options.A: It acts as the primary energy source for red blood cells
options.B: It directly destroys harmful bacteria in the stomach
options.C: It regulates bowel movements and prevents constipation
options.D: It stimulates the liver to produce more digestive bile

explanation: Fibre adds bulk to stool, facilitating smooth passage through the intestines and preventing sluggish bowel function. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h1)

question: What is the accepted average weight of a single standard fruit portion?
explanation: Global public health standards typically define one standard fruit or vegetable portion as approximately 80 grams. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h2)

question: A healthy adult patient asks how many fruit portions to eat daily. What is your best response?

options.A: Eat only one large fruit basket once a week
options.B: Aim for a minimum of two to three portions daily
options.C: Limit all fruit intake to avoid excess protein
options.D: Consume as many sweet tropical fruits as possible

explanation: Standard dietary guidelines recommend that adults consume at least two to three portions of fruit daily as part of a balanced diet. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h2)

question: What component of whole fruit is mostly lost during the extraction of clear fruit juice?
explanation: Squeezing and straining fruit removes the pulp and skin where the majority of beneficial dietary fibre is stored. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h3)

question: Why does drinking fruit juice cause a faster blood sugar spike than eating whole fruit?

options.A: Cold juice temperatures accelerate intestinal enzyme activity
options.B: The human stomach cannot absorb solid food nutrients
options.C: Liquid juice delivers free sugars rapidly without structural fibre
options.D: Juice contains added synthetic glucose that digests instantly

explanation: Without fibre to slow digestion, the sugars in juice enter the bloodstream much faster than when trapped inside whole fruit cells. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h3)

question: Which local Nigerian fruit is particularly known for containing the digestive enzyme papain?
explanation: Pawpaw contains papain, a natural proteolytic enzyme that aids in breaking down dietary proteins during digestion. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h4)

question: What is a major advantage of recommending seasonal local fruits to patients in Nigeria?

options.A: They are more affordable and retain higher nutrient levels
options.B: They contain zero natural sugars compared to imported options
options.C: They completely eliminate the need for drinking water
options.D: They can be stored at room temperature for several years

explanation: Local seasonal fruits require less storage and transport time, making them cheaper and fresher than imported alternatives. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h4)

question: Which strategy best helps a low-income patient increase their daily fruit intake?

options.A: Avoiding all perishable foods to save household money
options.B: Buying local fruits in season when market prices drop
options.C: Purchasing only imported organic berries from supermarkets
options.D: Relying exclusively on expensive vitamin C tablets

explanation: Purchasing seasonal local produce is the most cost-effective way to maintain adequate fruit intake on a limited budget. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h5)

question: Which of the following is NOT a recommended approach for managing fruit spoilage in tropical climates?

options.A: Utilizing frozen alternatives when fresh fruit is unavailable
options.B: Storing ripe fruits in cool, well-ventilated areas of the kitchen
options.C: Consuming seasonal produce promptly after purchase
options.D: Leaving fresh fruits sealed inside airtight plastic bags in the sun

explanation: Trapping fresh fruit in heat and airtight plastic accelerates moisture buildup, fungal growth, and rapid decay. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h5)
